workItem: Implement a read-only automated consistency validator for the canonical Project Value Chain and project-folder routing, reusing existing Governance/CI paths without creating a parallel authority plane.
workItemDE: Eine read-only automatisierte Konsistenzprüfung für die kanonische Project Value Chain und die Projektordner-Zuordnung implementieren und dabei bestehende Governance-/CI-Pfade wiederverwenden, ohne eine parallele Authority-Ebene zu erzeugen.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment.
releaseReason: The PVC consistency implementation was already merged through PR #662; the later claim-closure PR #669 was closed unmerged and left this metadata stale. Current main contains the implementation, so this writer is released without asserting that PR #669 merged.
